methodology.timing: protocol 2.0.0: 2 warmup(s) marked+discarded from aggregation, then 10 timed runs interleaved round-robin across languages; primary wall = median; spread = stdev/min/max + 1.96σ CI on mean
methodology.within_noise: When two languages' CI intervals overlap on an algorithm, the ranking is reported as within noise (no hard order).
methodology.speed: 40% ratio-to-best geo-median wall (Julia uses in-process ELAPSED_S floored to 5% process wall)
methodology.reliability: 15% ratio-to-best checksum pass rate on gated algos
methodology.cycle: 10% ratio-to-best geo-mean (compile + first verify run); interpreters compile=0
methodology.failures: checksum/compile fail → 2× slowest ok median/cycle on that algo (else TIMEOUT_S)
methodology.removed: cpu (was identical to speed via thru_vs_c)
methodology.raw_runs: Each target keeps raw_runs[] with warmup:true|false; times_s is timed-only.

category_winner_notes.reliability: 10-way tie at 100% gated checksum pass; no sole Reliability winner. Encoded as 'all' (display: All / tie).
